## ErrorDetailsByCode.COLLECTION_CHANGED property

The collection changed while it was being read, so no consistent result exists; the same request is correct and can be retried, from the first page if it was paged. No details: what identified the change (an item's identifier) may be user content.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly COLLECTION_CHANGED: NoDetails;
```
